resources.string:
Say hello to the new Sky Map

Sky Map has been completely rebuilt from scratch — a new rendering engine, a new astronomy engine and a new interface, made to be faster, more accurate and easier on the eyes. Version 2.1 builds on that with some of the most-requested features:

Sky Map on your home screen

Three new widgets put the sky in your launcher: Moon phase (the phase, how much is lit, and moonrise and moonset), Tonight\'s sky (sunset, when it gets dark, and the best sights tonight) and Sky countdown (days until the next meteor shower peak or moon event). Add one from the new Widgets menu item, or from your launcher\'s widget picker.

Steadier view

We\'ve improved the way Sky Map steadies the picture while you hold your phone still — it shakes less and keeps up better when you move. You can turn it off any time under Settings → Sensors → Smooth sensor movement if you\'d rather use the raw sensor.

Search the Help

Help is now searchable, and results jump straight to the relevant part of the app.

A new alt/az grid

Sky Map can now overlay a grid of altitude and azimuth lines on the map, alongside the existing celestial grid. It\'s off by default — turn it on from the layers menu.

Also new in version 2

  • A fresh look: the new Deep Space / Star Gold color scheme and sharper Sun, Moon and planet artwork.
  • More accurate Sun and Moon: the Moon sits where you see it, and eclipses and conjunctions land at the right minute.
  • A more realistic solar system: the Moon\'s phase is calculated from its true geometry, Venus, Mercury and Mars show phases, and you can view planets at their real size.
  • Lunar eclipses: the Moon turns its copper-red tint on the map.
  • Find more stars: 268 new IAU star names, and search by Bayer or Flamsteed designation — "α Cyg" finds Deneb.
  • Live readout: right ascension and declination, altitude and azimuth, and field of view, right on the map.
  • 28 languages, fully translated.

And this is just the start...

We have many long asked-for features coming very soon.
